{{Quote|And deep behind a security barrier in an Axum shipyard, technologists struggled to reverse-engineer the weapons and starship generators the Navy had captured at Sif-Alula.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
'''Sif-Alula''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] astronomical object located in the [[Trestis sector/Legends|Trestis sector]]. It was the namesake of the [[Sif-Alulan process]], in which the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]] studied and upgraded [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] technology in the build-up of the [[Waymancy Storm]] of [[7811 BBY]]. During that conflict, the Republic captured weapons and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] power generators of the [[Signatories of Waymancy]] at Sif-Alula, allowing the Republic to study the military technology of its enemy.

==Description==
Sif-Alula was a celestial body<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Sif-Alula system/Legends|Sif-Alula system]]. It was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Trestis sector/Legends|Trestis sector]], being located both in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the region.<ref name="Location" /> Sif-Alula's name was similar to that of<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC Sif-Uwana">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sif-Uwana system/Legends|Sif-Uwana system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sif-Uwana]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|151|Sif-Uwana}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] leading up to the [[Waymancy Storm]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> the group known as the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]], based in the [[Waymancy Hollow]], had studied and improved on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] technology,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> such as [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], in what was known as the [[Sif-Alulan process]].<ref name="EGTW" /> During the Waymancy Storm, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] captured weapons and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] generators of its enemy, the [[Signatories of Waymancy]], at Sif-Alula. Subsequently, Republic [[Tech specialist|technologists]] at a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] at [[Axum]] attempted to reverse-engineer<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the Sif-Alulan process<ref name="EGTW" /> which had been used in the manufacture of the captured technology.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

At a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]], Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] noted the importance to the Republic's war effort of the knowledge gained from the technology captured at Sif-Alula.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> Sif-Alula fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sif-Alula was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sif-Alula [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-8.<ref name="Location" />
